title: FATF Recommendation 10 — Customer Due Diligence
summary: Ongoing customer due diligence and transaction monitoring.

title: FATF Recommendation 11 — Record Keeping
summary: Retain transaction and decision records for audit and reconstruction.

title: FATF Recommendation 12 — Politically Exposed Persons
summary: Enhanced due diligence and senior management approval for PEPs.

title: FATF Recommendation 15 — New Technologies
summary: Risk-based controls for new technologies and delivery channels.

title: FATF Recommendation 20 — Suspicious Transaction Reporting
summary: Report suspicious transactions to the competent authority.
